name: United Kingdom
contextBlurb: The UK's dedicated cryptoasset framework is now legally made but not yet in force. The Financial Services and Markets Act 2000 (Cryptoassets) Regulations 2026 were made on 4 February 2026 and include issuing qualifying stablecoin within the future regulatory perimeter, but commencement is set for October 2027. HM Treasury issued a draft amending SI on 21 April 2026 to improve stablecoin payment use cases, while the FCA consulted on guidance on 15 April 2026 and plans to begin taking authorisation applications from September 2026.

stablecoinMeta.classificationNote: Regulated cryptoasset activities under FSMA (via amended RAO) for issuing qualifying stablecoins and safeguarding qualifying cryptoassets; not e-money or a security by default—bespoke activity with specific rules.

regulators.name: Financial Conduct Authority
regulators.role: Will authorise issuers and custodians; set conduct, safeguarding and prudential rules for qualifying stablecoins.

regulators.name: Bank of England
regulators.role: Will regulate systemic stablecoins/payment systems at scale; separate systemic regime.
